title: 경기도 수원시와 용인시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:30036:20190813:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 경기도 수원시와 용인시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDA <No. 30036, August 13, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date on which 30 days have elapsed after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Dispositions, etc.) A public notification, disposition, or other act made before this Decree enters into force by the head of a former local government or the head of an agency under that person's jurisdiction in relation to an area incorporated into another local government under this Decree shall be deemed an act made by the head of the local government acquiring jurisdiction over that area under this Decree or the head of an agency under that person's jurisdiction. An application, report, or other act made to the head of the former local government or the head of an agency under that person's jurisdiction shall be deemed to have been made to the head of the local government acquiring jurisdiction over that area under this Decree or the head of an agency under that person's jurisdiction.

Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations) Where any statute or regulation in force when this Decree enters into force designates all or part of a city area changed under this Decree as an area or jurisdictional area, the relevant statute or regulation shall apply, until it is amended after this Decree enters into force, as if the changed city area remained within the area or jurisdictional area of the city before the change.
